title: EE69019: Instrumentation Laboratory I
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1.
Level Measurement using capacitive Transducer.2.
Bridge Amplifier
for Temperature measurement.3.
IC temperature sensor ( AD 590) for
temperature measurement and cold junction compensation.4.
Study and
testing of LVDT.5.
Pressure Transducers and its signal conditioning.
Piezo Electric Transducers and its signal conditioning.6.
Study of various
flow measurement devices (V notch, Hotwire , Optical and Rotameter).7.
Strain gauge and its signal conditioning
Study of hall effect transducer.8.
Speed measurement using various sensor like magnetic, photo electric pick
up.9.
Group-wise Miniprojects
